title: Trader Diary: 1% Dip Panic
content:
📉 Bitcoin slides 1% → My heart does a double‑take.
💭 3 AM: “Just a tiny bit of extra leverage, no biggie.”
🚀 5 AM: “Why is my margin call louder than my alarm?”
lesson: Never let a 1% dip be the excuse to crank up leverage – respect your stop‑loss.
question: Who else added leverage at a 1% dip and instantly regretted it? Share your war stories 👇
